virgo_20.summary: Watchful self-preservation: health, money, and one's interests well guarded.
virgo_20.fullText: A merchant with his money bags; a man putting a will to the fire. The merchant is shrewdness about money, which can harden into meanness. The burnt will is resourcefulness of a finer kind, the skill to keep what matters out of other people's reach. Placements pay close attention to the body, to diet and to natural law, and keep a defensive eye on anyone who might obstruct them. They prefer to face a difficulty directly. Mimicry, verse and natural science are the usual talents.

virgo_21.summary: Resourcefulness in pursuit of wealth, with a show that outruns the substance.
virgo_21.fullText: A man in showy clothes clutching money bags; a will being burned; an ostrich puffed up with its own importance. The first figure is acquisitive and rather pleased with himself, and the ostrich says how little may stand behind the display. The burnt will is the degree's real ability: finesse in protecting one's rights from interference. Placements keep fit, take an interest in diet, and often have a gift for mimicry or poetry. What they chase hardest is money, and that is the thing to watch.

virgo_22.summary: Magnetism and appetite, tested by vanity and by flattery.
virgo_22.fullText: A handsome woman admiring herself in a mirror; a revel in the woods; a forest with the sun coming through it. The first two are the hazard: a worldly, sensuous nature that flattery and desire can lead into disgrace. The sunlit forest is the other outcome, a person respected among equals who founds a way of thinking of their own. Mind and memory are both remarkable. Honours tend to come early, and the tradition warns that a hasty judgment is what loses them.

virgo_23.summary: A gentle wanderer, ahead of the times and a little apart from them.
virgo_23.fullText: A ship under full sail; Astraea turning from a world of bloodshed; rings of light in the sky. The ship gives a roving, fanciful nature drawn to travel and the sea. Astraea is refinement and sympathy that cannot stomach cruelty. The rings mark someone living in a world of their own, whose ideas arrive before their audience does. Placements are enthusiastic, often medically able, and good at telling a political story. They can feel out of step with the age they were born into.

virgo_24.summary: Solitude and estrangement on one side, a gift that draws a crowd on the other.
virgo_24.fullText: A naked man weeping on a rock in the sea; a giant gripping a woman; a full assembly room and a pianist at work. The exile on the rock is isolation, melancholy and distrust of people. The giant warns against force and the vain misuse of power. The pianist is the contradiction this degree lives with: eloquence or musicianship that makes its owner popular. Placements work hard, rise and fall more than most, and find both society and themselves difficult to make out.

virgo_26.summary: Warm friendship, art and long sight; a poor head for a gamble.
virgo_26.fullText: Two old friends walking together at ease; an ancient temple of the Muses; a man running after a meteor in the dark. The friends are a sociable, sympathetic nature that attracts sincere company and sees far ahead, while managing the short term badly. The temple is a quiet devotion to art, culture and philosophy. The meteor is the warning, and it is specific: leave speculation and hazardous ventures alone. Placements are cheerful and are happiest when being useful to someone.

virgo_27.summary: A sharp critical eye, strong in letters, undone only when it cannot act.
virgo_27.fullText: A broken hammer lying on a bench; a newspaper critic in his theatre seat; a clear sky full of sun. The hammer is ability with no force behind it, a clumsiness in practical matters that leaves a person open to being used. The critic is the opposite case: observant, discriminating and quick to turn a situation to account. The sky promises prosperity and contentment. The tradition counts this among the strongest literary degrees, with blunt honesty and good taste.

virgo_28.summary: Generous industry: heavy work accepted, and abundance to show for it.
virgo_28.fullText: A broad tree weighed down with fruit; dockers loading a ship; a man turning a great wheel. The tree is a rich and generous disposition, success, and a large family. The dockers are self-denial for the sake of a task that needs care, with work treated as a form of devotion. The wheel is a laborious life whose effect on the world is out of proportion to its noise. Placements are prudent, forever planning, and commonly drawn to astrology and the occult.

virgo_30.summary: Truth pursued without compromise, at some cost to peace of mind.
virgo_30.fullText: A man with no head, or wrapped in black; oranges blown down from a tree; a landscape half in sun and half in fog. The shrouded man is the recluse, melancholy and eccentric, whose late-night study of hidden things can unsettle the mind. The fallen fruit is hard circumstance imposed by fate or by other people's deceit, borne without bitterness or fault-finding. The divided landscape is a discriminating mind that has come down on the side of truth. Placements may hoard, or feel tied by what they own.

libra_1.summary: Strict fairness and strong magnetism, with a temper to keep in hand.
libra_1.fullText: Honest to a fault and exact about justice, this degree thinks before it acts and plans with care. Placements are warm, attractive to others, and often artistically able. The difficulty is self-assertion. Too much independence turns a disagreement into a contest of wills, and the contest can end in standing alone. The instinct to protect and defend is sound; what needs softening is the speed and force with which it goes into action.

libra_2.summary: Refined, kind and artistically gifted; easily hurt and often misread.
libra_2.fullText: One of the gentler degrees. Placements are sincere and generous, with good taste and a real gift for music or art. Intelligence is quick and the understanding of people borders on the psychic, which is where the visionary work comes from. The cost is thin skin. They can be led by stronger personalities and misunderstood by nearly everyone else, and when the world shows its rougher side they tend to withdraw into sadness and wait it out.

libra_3.summary: A fine mind in a constrained life, needing method and steadiness.
libra_3.fullText: Reserved, sympathetic and inventive, with a pull toward science, medicine or the less visible laws of nature. The mind is the strength. Circumstances are the trouble: placements feel held back by frail health, by a narrow situation, or by ties they cannot quite name, and outward success comes slowly. The risks are bitterness toward people, long low moods, and unreliable company. A clear, methodical way of working is the protection, along with staying out of things they do not understand.

libra_4.summary: Deep feeling and fine skill, with trust that is easily misplaced.
libra_4.fullText: Compassionate and instinctive, with a cultivated taste for art and philosophy and a hand for exact work such as surgery. The emotional life runs deep, and that is where the difficulty lies. This degree has a record of loneliness, of abrupt loss of position, and of partnerships or marriages that turn bitter. Much of it follows from choosing confidants badly. Placements need to judge people practically, and to notice when self-absorption is making the judgment for them.

libra_5.summary: Courage and skill that win by decisive action, and can overdo it.
libra_5.fullText: Self-reliant, ambitious in the things of the mind, and good with the hands. Placements lead well and may excel in the arts or in surgery. They are enthusiasts and will fight for a cause they believe is right, usually by going straight at it, and power tends to follow. The weakness is impatience. Force is preferred to diplomacy, and that brings quarrels that damage and a real risk of physical injury. The fighting spirit needs governing more than it needs encouragement.

libra_6.summary: Endurance and hard, plain work on a difficult road.
libra_6.fullText: A life of patience and long effort, most of it without glamour. The mind is exact and adjusts well, yet the route to success is rough and placements may waver along it, or turn dictatorial once they have authority. This degree produces the pioneer who does the labour and the judge who applies the rule. Either can slide into self-righteousness, harshness, or too much force, and the tradition says plainly that bitterness and violence are what undo the work.

libra_7.summary: Romantic idealism drawn toward risk, and needing a hand on the brake.
libra_7.fullText: A sociable, sympathetic degree that attaches itself to causes and will give things up for them. Placements feel steered by fate more than by plan, and are pulled toward travel, danger and whatever is being kept hidden. The weakness is being talked into things: worldly temptation on one side, heated quarrels on the other. The tradition is blunt that a fall from good standing is possible here, and that self-control is what prevents it.

libra_8.summary: Sound judgment and enterprise, shadowed by grief and by risk of loss.
libra_8.fullText: Discerning, analytical and enterprising, this degree weighs the world accurately. The temperament is another matter: sensitive, retiring and inclined to sadness. Placements often meet bereavement early, or carry a loneliness that colours the rest. The practical warning is unusually firm. Speculation and risky ventures of any kind are to be avoided, because sudden loss and the forfeiting of what one owns are the characteristic misfortunes here.

libra_9.summary: A bold, critical leader whose sharp tongue invites disputes.
libra_9.fullText: Capable, worldly and brave, with ability in science, command or exploration. Placements are witty and will not give up a principle. They are also assertive and highly critical, and the combination lands them in confrontations, lawsuits, and now and then a public scandal. Stubbornness and carelessness make the setbacks worse. The remedy is unglamorous: a deliberate effort to keep balance and to prefer peace when peace is on offer.

libra_10.summary: Courteous, reflective and simple in taste; at home in solitude.
libra_10.fullText: Mature and well-mannered, with a feeling for beauty, plain tastes, and good sense about money. The intellect is dry, objective and thoughtful, and turns toward philosophy, religion, or the question of how a society's ills might be mended. Placements are sensitive and sometimes melancholy. They look for quiet, in solitude or in the countryside, and that is where they get through their difficulties and find a peace that holds.

libra_11.summary: Patient reform or rural good sense, with two sides to reconcile.
libra_11.fullText: Observant, patient and forward-looking. Placements care about social welfare and justice, or else about the quiet shrewdness of country life. They have natural tact and a real sympathy for people who have been left out. In spite of that they meet opposition, are misread, and go through spells of isolation. The underlying issue is a double nature. High ideals have to be matched with practical, down-to-earth judgment before either does much good.

libra_12.summary: Ability that succeeds by reasoning and effort, and falters on self-doubt.
libra_12.fullText: Intelligent and thoroughly capable. What this degree achieves, it achieves by hard work and orderly thinking; luck has little to do with it. Two things get in the way. Confidence is low, and the temperament can be unsteady or frivolous, so chances go by untaken. Worse, trust is sometimes handed to people who are cleverer than they are honest. With some firmness and practicality, placements put considerable talent to proper use.

libra_13.summary: An original, refined thinker who comes into his own late.
libra_13.fullText: Sensitive and progressive, with ideas that are distinctly unusual. Loneliness is common here, as are low spirits and a rather ascetic withdrawal. Close relationships are the hard part: marriage and partnership can be full of misunderstanding, affection that goes unexpressed, or outright disappointment, because confidence is lacking or feeling is too strong. Success and peace of mind usually arrive in later life, once placements accept their independence and the particular cast of their mind.

libra_14.summary: Perceptive and many-sided, needing a firm sense of self.
libra_14.fullText: Highly perceptive and creative, with something of the medium about it. Placements get through life by taking on roles, and may wear several faces in turn. They react strongly to surroundings, to food, and to subtler influences, so overindulgence and fixation are the two things to guard against. They can also crowd the people they love. Once their own identity is settled, the adaptability and the fine concentration of mind produce a good deal.

libra_15.summary: A quick, versatile communicator who reflects the company kept.
libra_15.fullText: Mentally alert and talkative, drawn to writing, to matters of health, or to clubs and brotherhoods. The disposition is impressionable and a little light. Placements take on the colour of whatever is around them, which makes them good mimics and good writers. The same trait brings indecision, romantic muddles and shallowness. Sincerity has to be cultivated on purpose, and the appetite for pleasure kept within bounds.

libra_16.summary: Brilliance, music and deep reserves, wasted by drift or needless risk.
libra_16.fullText: Energetic and gifted, strongly musical, with large reserves of strength and a talent for strategy in science or politics. There is a natural feeling for rhythm, law and order. Oddly, the faults run the other way. Placements take chances they have no need to take, or else coast along whichever road is easiest. Hidden dangers are part of this degree, and getting past them takes sharp judgment and a refusal to trade away one's ideals.

libra_17.summary: An inventive, independent mind, productive once the fault-finding stops.
libra_17.fullText: Active and fiercely independent. This is a degree that can take a large, visionary idea and turn it into something practical and solid. Artistic or spiritual sensitivity usually comes with it. So does a critical, quarrelsome or secretive streak, which leads to serious disputes, foolish moves, and trouble with authority. The energy is progressive and the results can last. Everything depends on keeping the habit of finding fault under control.

libra_18.summary: Hospitable and eloquent, ambitious abroad and peaceable at home.
libra_18.fullText: Warm, romantic and open-handed, with marked gifts for writing, public speaking and reading people. Friends come easily. So does ambition, since placements want recognition and would like to be thought great. The risks are being taken advantage of and being drawn into small, tiring arguments. A sharp critical wit sits alongside a real wish for harmony and a quiet home, and the two have to be kept in proportion.

libra_19.summary: Mastery through concentration, in the mystic or the public figure.
libra_19.fullText: A focused, commanding intellect that often rises to eminence in its field, and occasionally to genius. It shows in two forms: the quiet religious mystic, and the active, hospitable public figure. Both depend on intense concentration and a shrewd reading of human nature. Placements can sustain hard labour and long reflection. What brings success in the end is a strategic, unbending commitment to the highest thing they believe in.

libra_20.summary: Charm, good fortune and public devotion, endangered by extravagance.
libra_20.fullText: Charismatic and lucky, with an intense temperament and a deep feeling for beauty, religion and the arts. Placements can rise to real public prominence and are natural peacemakers, bringing unwavering devotion to whatever they take as their calling. The weakness is plain and persistent. A taste for extravagance, and for escape into pleasure, keeps threatening what they have built. Worldly success here is considerable and needs protecting from its owner.

libra_21.summary: Frank charm and strong will, too ready to trust appearances.
libra_21.fullText: Strong-willed, open and outgoing, with ability in science or in the magical arts. The warning attached to this degree concerns surfaces. Placements trust what looks good and give way to physical pleasure, and so can be cheated, led off course, or caught by a sudden reversal. None of it is inevitable. Intelligence turned inward and firm self-control keep misplaced trust from doing harm, and leave a lively energy free for solid achievement.

libra_22.summary: Real talent in art or learning, lost only by wasting time.
libra_22.fullText: Truthful and fair-minded, with a marked gift for music, writing or scholarship. The trouble is a divided temperament: wise one week and careless the next, planning a thing and then failing to begin it. What this degree stands to lose, it loses by neglect; an opportunity or an inheritance passes to someone who simply turned up. Placements do well once they stop treating their own ability as something that will keep.

libra_23.summary: A restless, inquiring mind that wants to see for itself.
libra_23.fullText: Many gifts, strong vitality and artistic ability, all pointed outward. Placements want movement, travel and discovery on a large scale. The type is the astronomer with the whole sky to study, or the independent researcher working out nature's hidden laws, and in either case someone who intends to answer to nobody. Tenacity brings success almost as a matter of course, so long as the search for knowledge stays tied to fact.

libra_24.summary: Proud ambition that overlooks the detail an enemy will use.
libra_24.fullText: Great pride and a wish to stand apart and be distinguished. The tradition attaches serious misfortune to this degree, and plots by jealous rivals. Placements are optimistic and confident to the point of carelessness. They spread their energy thin and miss the small facts on which their own safety depends. The higher the position, the harder the fall, and what prevents it is caution, close attention to detail, and discipline.

libra_25.summary: Attractive, peaceable and musical, with the senses pulling hard.
libra_25.fullText: An even temper, clear musical ability, and a polished, forward-looking mind. Placements are romantic and well liked. They are also impulsive and fond of pleasure, and can end up ruled by their own shifting wants or by a stronger will than theirs. Vanity is part of the risk. Personal dignity at its best is possible here, and it depends on setting restraint and clear foresight against the sensuous, artistic side.

libra_26.summary: A skilled handler of people who must not simply follow the crowd.
libra_26.fullText: Firm, generous and extremely sensitive, with a refined knack for dealing with people. Success often comes through public service or local politics. Placements defend their rights with real courage and no hesitation. The weak point is elsewhere: they adjust their views too readily to suit whoever is around them. Echoing the majority is the temptation. The degree does well when it keeps its own integrity and its own sense of what matters.

libra_27.summary: Courage turned to quiet uses: contentment, shelter and peace-making.
libra_27.fullText: Physical and moral courage of a high order, spent on a calm and harmonious life instead of on worldly ambition. Placements are closely tuned to their surroundings. They spread comfort without apparent effort and have a soothing, healing effect on the people near them. They need very little to be happy and keep clear of complicated disputes. The result is a quietly influential life founded on compassion and loyalty.

libra_28.summary: Dignity, persistence and duty; goals reached by plain exertion.
libra_28.fullText: A sympathetic listener who nonetheless believes that practical hard work answers most of life's problems. Placements are content with the well-worn path and a conservative way of doing things. There is real humanity here and an undemonstrative kind of bravery. By patient industry and stubborn determination they find, in time, the value and the lasting success that lie inside ordinary or laborious circumstances.

libra_29.summary: Quiet shrewdness under a plain surface, with fortunes that can dim.
libra_29.fullText: Studious and inward, with a subtle, attractive wisdom that an unassuming manner tends to hide. Placements are liable to melancholy, to a gloomy indifference, and to unexpected eclipses of their fortunes, and may take a fatalistic view of all three. The practical warning is strict: no bold speculation, no gambling, no blind trust in others, since setbacks here are heavy. Possessions need guarding and resilience needs building, steadily.

libra_30.summary: Pure-hearted idealism that does not notice the danger approaching.
libra_30.fullText: The solitary and the innocent. Placements are individual and idealistic, and find ordinary modern life very hard to fit into. They lose themselves in daydreams, in moody isolation, or in a comfortable lethargy, and meanwhile fail to see real physical or social dangers drawing closer. The indifference is what invites misfortune. This degree needs to wake up to its actual surroundings and get a firm footing in them, and soon.

scorpio_1.summary: Fierce desire and strategic force, best spent on obstacles.
scorpio_1.fullText: Passionate, forceful and ready for a fight. Placements have real magnetism and a strategist's head, and feel pushed to widen their social or intellectual world. Jealousy and rage come with the territory, as do conflicts that destroy more than they settle. The test is whether reason or brute force gets used. When the energy goes into building something, this degree clears obstacles that stop most people and reaches the top of its field.

scorpio_2.summary: Quiet strength and deep understanding, liable to harden around the past.
scorpio_2.fullText: Intelligent, meditative and self-reliant. Placements understand things thoroughly and plan with care. They are ambitious and generous, and carry a calm authority that people respect without being asked to. The danger is rigidity. Old memories, fixed convictions and pride can hold this degree in one place, and that is how it betrays itself. Success comes with letting old feeling go and accepting that human nature is changeable and complicated.

scorpio_3.summary: Contemplative or artistic gifts, looking for a community to share them.
scorpio_3.fullText: Thoughtful and sensitive, often with artistic ability. Placements want cooperation and shared undertakings, and can produce serious philosophical or creative work. Disillusionment is the recurring problem. So is a swing between two poles: austerity of the spirit, and plain appetite. Absolute demands make both worse. A steady, generous relation to the people and places around them lets a wide range of talent settle into a full life.

scorpio_4.summary: Intense devotion that passes through storms and comes out able to heal.
scorpio_4.fullText: Restless, intense and deeply loyal. Life here moves by emotional storms and thorough transformations. Placements have great willpower and like to plan and organise, yet they draw crises toward them, or walk into one on purpose, as a way of forcing renewal. They are willing to look at the darkest and most disordered parts of existence. Doing so clears out the past, and in time gives them an unusual ability to heal and guide others.

scorpio_5.summary: Watchful resolve and endurance that turns a vision into fact.
scorpio_5.fullText: Dedicated, vigilant and firm, with a great capacity for sustained work. The presence is authoritative, sometimes mystical. Placements hold out against pressure and defend their principles. What they have to get past is in themselves: stubbornness, fatalism, and a tendency to be of two minds. Their method is quiet continuity and care over detail, and by it they bring an abstract idea down to something solid that lasts.

scorpio_6.summary: Magnetic industry and many talents, finding treasure where others missed it.
scorpio_6.fullText: Ambitious, hard-working and attractive to others, with several talents and a strong will to succeed. This degree turns up hidden value, in the ground or in a situation. Resourcefulness and determination bring wealth or reputation, often when nobody expected it. The difficulty is governing so much energy. Greed, extreme risk and overreach are the ways it goes wrong. It does best when the pioneering spirit is given something broad and forward-moving to work on.

scorpio_7.summary: Fearless inquiry into what is hidden, needing a tighter rein.
scorpio_7.fullText: Brave, alert and intensely communicative. Placements go straight into the concealed side of life and of people's minds, and do not flinch in a crisis. They are restless, though, and can be sharp to the point of rudeness, with passions that pull several ways at once. Small quarrels and showing off are the distractions. With self-restraint, a real talent for investigation earns lasting honour and does some public good.

scorpio_8.summary: A sensitive, complex nature that finds its strength in protecting others.
scorpio_8.fullText: Compassionate and emotionally intricate. Early life may bring isolation or hardship. Placements are reflective and magnetic, and carry on a long inner struggle between what they have learned and what still shadows them from the past. Bitterness is one way out and hard materialism is another, and neither works. Their strength, and their recovery, comes from sheltering and guiding people who are vulnerable or badly placed.

scorpio_9.summary: A shrewd, observant mind kept behind a mask.
scorpio_9.fullText: Sharp-eyed, authoritative and difficult to read. Placements hide their depth, and their vulnerability, behind a guarded manner or a playful one. They solve problems brilliantly, overcome a good deal in themselves, and are driven to investigate the unknown and master their surroundings. The faults are those of a clever person: manipulation, jealousy that goes deep, and cynicism. Acute perception can build or destroy, and the choice is the point of this degree.

scorpio_10.summary: Loyal company, kept at a careful distance.
scorpio_10.fullText: Intuitive and well connected, and more guarded than the easy manner suggests. Placements prize fellowship and shared experience, yet hold part of themselves back, swinging between excessive caution and sudden rashness. Old fears and old grievances sit underneath that. The work of the degree is to turn them into steadiness, after which the friendships it wants become possible: ones built on trust and a common purpose.

scorpio_11.summary: Poetic and protective, with more anxiety than the facts warrant.
scorpio_11.fullText: Imaginative, sensitive and watchful. Placements love beauty, nature and the small pleasures of ordinary life. The same imagination supplies worries. They are over-cautious about hidden dangers, subject to sudden insecurity, and may brood, or feel that unseen opponents are close by. The trap is a particular one: fearing risks that do not exist while missing ones that do. Shyness balanced with some grounded courage frees the artistic and protective gifts.

scorpio_12.summary: A private, occult turn of mind, defended by prudence.
scorpio_12.fullText: Intense and secretive, with a strong bent toward the occult. Placements get through difficulty by foresight and great caution. The temperament is unusual, sensitive, sometimes eccentric, and they keep their distance, standing alone like a tower. Because they sense opponents or concealed dangers around them, their defences are formidable. If the darker, vengeful feelings are not kept in check, the same resourcefulness sinks into destructive gloom or cunning self-interest.

scorpio_13.summary: Psychic independence, divided between solitude and open-handed company.
scorpio_13.fullText: Independent, psychic and emotionally sensitive, and capable of rising to real authority and commanding respect. There is a core of stability. Placements need solitude to sort through feelings that are complex and keep shifting. They also have a jovial, over-generous side that gathers all sorts of associates, some of whom take advantage where judgment is lacking. The influence of this degree on its surroundings is strong and outlasts the moment.

scorpio_14.summary: Charm and business sense that scatter without concentration.
scorpio_14.fullText: A magnetic personality, good commercial judgment, and an open, guileless courage. Placements are well fitted for public or strategic work. What threatens all of it is a restless mind that spreads itself across too many shallow interests. Beyond that lies a fatalistic laziness, or leaning too much on what others do. The remedy is single: pick one purpose and apply steady, determined attention to it.

scorpio_15.summary: Adventurous, sociable and vigorous, led by heart more than head.
scorpio_15.fullText: Enthusiastic and energetic, with a love of travel, new experience and company. Placements read people almost by instinct, which wins them loyal friends and carries them through complicated social situations. Their courage is impulsive. They can act selfishly or start quarrels, and serious conflict follows. The old warning is of sudden ruin, fortunes wrecked like a ship. Less risk and more real give-and-take with others is what prevents it.

scorpio_16.summary: Benevolence under trial, held up by faith.
scorpio_16.fullText: Ardent, kind and generous, moved by a humane wish to comfort and encourage others. The path is hard. Severe trials demand fortitude, patience and a soldier's endurance, and placements contest every worldly disadvantage put in front of them. Their real strength lies deeper, in spiritual faith and a longing for peace. Two things to avoid: fatalistic despair, and growing attached to one's own suffering.

scorpio_17.summary: Passionate, artistic and chivalrous, at risk from its own appetites.
scorpio_17.fullText: Energetic and romantic, with a real gift for poetry, beauty and expression. Instincts are bold and sensual. Placements look for intensity, for the exotic, and sometimes for entanglements that are plainly dangerous. They can be chivalrous and will defend an ideal bravely. They can also be carried off by appetite, or suffer a serious reversal for want of moral restraint. Desire reined in, and energy given a creative object, is the route to success.

scorpio_18.summary: Magnetic and pleasure-loving, demanding freedom and prone to jealousy.
scorpio_18.fullText: A contradictory character: it insists on complete personal freedom and tries to control everyone nearby. Placements have a natural feeling for grace, for music and for strict justice. Their peace is disturbed by suspicion, concealed resentment and destructive jealousy. They like pleasure, flattery and strong sensation, and these can hide a danger until it is close. Fulfilment depends on taming a harsh, combative instinct before passion turns into poisonous mistrust.

scorpio_19.summary: Formidable intellect and ambition; a strong ally and a dangerous enemy.
scorpio_19.fullText: Tireless, independent and commanding, able to reach the highest honours and carry out very large ambitions. Wit is sharp, psychological insight deep, strategy formidable. The warning is equally strong. Unchecked aggression, fierce jealousy and a self-righteous taste for conflict belong to this degree, and at the worst make a person the terror of their own community. The combative passions have to be turned into leadership with a high aim.

scorpio_20.summary: Tenacity that fights its way up from early obstacles.
scorpio_20.fullText: Driven by a restless wish to expand, to discover, and finally to master itself. The will is hard to break and gets the better of serious obstacles early in life. Placements are passionate and competitive by nature, and treat life as a contest between their own ego and something higher. Fortunes rise and fall, and confrontations are frequent. Persistence and a refusal to accept constraint bring public honour, independence and solid achievement in the end.

scorpio_21.summary: Blunt independence that obeys its own conscience and pays for it.
scorpio_21.fullText: Direct to the point of harshness. Placements see things without the usual social politeness and say so. Under it is a basic, almost primitive need for liberty. Nervous restlessness makes for a hard road and can reverse their fortunes more than once. They hold on to their autonomy all the same. Given the choice, this degree follows its conscience and takes the consequences, and will not submit to authority imposed from outside.

scorpio_22.summary: Honest hard work, scattered by impulse and stubbornness.
scorpio_22.fullText: Industrious and bluntly honest. The trouble is impulse: placements take up risky or impractical schemes on a whim and waste their resources doing it. They will not listen to advice, and are too easily taken with surface glitter, so the same failure tends to come round again. Frustration and exhaustion are where it leads. The aggressive drive needs a constructive, social outlet, which is something this degree has to learn.

scorpio_23.summary: Contentment in useful work, and the knack of refining raw instinct.
scorpio_23.fullText: Modest and thoroughly capable. Placements are happy and at peace in simple country surroundings or in the duties of a household. They have an inborn ability to lift the lower, animal drives into something spiritual or creative. Resourcefulness sees them through hardship and gives them secure footing. Patient work and depth of feeling do the rest, and they end with a world that is recognisably their own.

scorpio_24.summary: A divided degree: heroic sacrifice or predatory greed.
scorpio_24.fullText: Close acquaintance with the harsh side of life. It produces one of two characters: the brave soul who goes into dark circumstances to help others, or the predator who is after gain and nothing else. Placements face real tests of meaning and must bring their highest inspirations down into daily practice. Pessimism and the wish to escape are the dangers. Given in to, they leave great energy caught in a destructive materialism.

scorpio_25.summary: A piercing mind that sees the structure beneath the surface.
scorpio_25.fullText: Analytical and determined. Placements look past appearances to the framework that holds a thing up, and to the motive behind an action. They may give themselves bravely to an idealistic or humanitarian aim. Caution is needed in two places. One is a careless disregard for their own safety. The other is a cynical fascination with dark and destructive truths. Either brings hardship and isolation that could have been avoided.

scorpio_26.summary: Natural authority and a persuasive tongue, used on behalf of many.
scorpio_26.fullText: Born to command and gifted in speech. Placements can lead or teach large numbers of people and do it well. They are in touch with very old instincts, adapt quickly to new surroundings, and accept heavy responsibility without fuss. Tact is part of the equipment. The characteristic role is the philanthropist who takes up the cause of the disadvantaged, or the pioneer of some new way of organising society.

scorpio_27.summary: Conviction brave enough to go into rough water.
scorpio_27.fullText: A determined, inquiring mind that will take a real risk to find something out. Placements are dependable and good at gathering people around what a community values and is proud of. Everything rests on the integrity of the belief. Where the faith stays honest, this is courage in service of an ideal; where it sours, the same force shows up as cunning self-interest, aggression, and a refusal to give any ground.

scorpio_28.summary: A studious authority that gives up comfort for a calling.
scorpio_28.fullText: Marked aptitude for science, for teaching, or for serious philosophical inquiry. Placements are devoted to their principles and feel bound to a cause larger than themselves. For its sake they will do without whatever is not essential. They work by strategy and have considerable personal charm, and prominence commonly follows. The condition is focus: the eye has to stay on the final aim and not wander from it.

scorpio_29.summary: Quiet research and strategy, and the cutting of ties that have had their day.
scorpio_29.fullText: Wise, studious and adaptable, with a strategist's intellect. It suits exacting scientific work, diplomatic negotiation, or operations carried on out of sight. Placements have a close connection with the hidden forces of life, and it gives them power that others feel. The lesson is release. Once old attachments are let go, this degree is capable of bringing about change that is sweeping and skilfully managed.

scorpio_30.summary: Heavy inner pressure that needs a safe way out.
scorpio_30.fullText: A complicated, burdened nature. Placements struggle with deep dilemmas, often distrust themselves, and want a spiritual breakthrough badly. They soak up the heavier moods of the people around them and feel stuck at the very edge of change, with gloomy forebodings for company. Frustration that builds up this way can turn destructive. Safe, imaginative outlets relieve it, and what finally resolves it is yielding to a higher understanding.

sagittarius_1.summary: A penetrating, independent mind suited to exact work.
sagittarius_1.fullText: Intuition here is striking: it gets to the bottom of a puzzle and sees through a falsehood. The bent is toward science, philosophy, or anything requiring precision. Placements want complete freedom and chafe at practical limits, and may go through lean periods because they prefer a plain, natural life to a role forced on them. Eloquence and obvious competence bring success and public honour in time. They need to trust their ability, and to stay civil when their independence is questioned.

sagittarius_2.summary: Energy and romance in search of adventure, with a temper to match.
sagittarius_2.fullText: A lover of the wild and the romantic. Placements are strongly driven and take on hazardous, exciting projects that bring them into conflict or physical danger. The mind is visionary, drawn to art, to logic and to high ideals. Without restraint, a hot temper produces sudden quarrels, enemies and heavy setbacks. Success comes from curbing restlessness and rebellion, and giving the passion a focused task that calls for precision.

sagittarius_3.summary: Determined strength that steps forward to right a wrong.
sagittarius_3.fullText: Powerful and able, often with a talent for art or for construction. There is an intensity about this degree, at times warlike, that wins loyal followers and equally determined opponents. Early life may hold shadows or family secrets, and these set placements on risky undertakings meant to bring something hidden into the light. Malice is the trap. Lasting standing comes when the raw, passionate instinct is raised toward mercy and unselfish, humane ends.

sagittarius_4.summary: Affectionate and inventive, fond of exploring, careless of the edge.
sagittarius_4.fullText: Sensitive and imaginative, with a mind suited to precise work in the arts or sciences and a real love of a peaceful home. Against that sits a restless, impulsive streak. Placements take reckless chances, walk close to the precipice, or simply wander. They tend not to see danger coming. Hasty decisions are what cause the sudden fall, or the painful separation from people they love. Foresight and a check on overconfidence are the cure.

sagittarius_5.summary: Cultured enthusiasm and sharp perception, impatient of limits.
sagittarius_5.fullText: Lively, expressive and refined, with keen perception and a lasting appetite for adventure. Placements are kindly and cultivated and may do excellent work in science, teaching or the arts. They want exotic experience and total freedom, and have little patience for social constraint. Feeling runs unsteady. Projects need grounding, or considerable intellectual wealth gets squandered. Misplaced trust and impulsive extremes are the other ways this degree comes to grief.

sagittarius_6.summary: Versatile, willing service, content with little credit.
sagittarius_6.fullText: Industrious and cooperative. Placements are happiest when serving others or practising a useful art. They have philosophical depth, a love of nature and a talent for communication. The disposition is yielding and too sympathetic, which lays them open to being used. Much of their work is done out of sight, without due credit or pay. They are content anyway, adaptable and unpretentiously wise, and their lives are peaceful ones spent improving the community.

sagittarius_7.summary: Sociable optimism that would rather coast than strive.
sagittarius_7.fullText: Easygoing, cheerful and fond of harmony. Placements appreciate culture, books and the good things of life, and rely a great deal on charm and luck. Success can come through speculation, writing or education. The weakness is a strong dislike of hard effort, together with a habit of gambling on fate. Opportunities are missed and the result can be shallow. Real accomplishment asks for self-discipline, moderation in pleasure, and concentrated work.

sagittarius_8.summary: Everything staked on one throw; a life of high peaks and deep troughs.
sagittarius_8.fullText: Thoughtful, strongly driven and intellectually powerful, with a great deal of courage. This degree will risk everything on a single decisive venture. Bold optimism and force of will can win brilliant victories and positions of leadership. Recklessness or a materialistic streak can just as easily bring sudden ruin, exhaustion or bodily danger. What saves placements is faith that holds, resilience over time, and a preference for real wisdom above accumulation.

sagittarius_9.summary: Zeal and versatility, short on practical foresight.
sagittarius_9.fullText: An energetic, adaptable mind on fire with inspiring ideas and philosophical interests. Placements learn fast and do well in public speaking, literature or scientific inquiry. The enthusiasm tends to outrun the planning. Energy is scattered, quarrels start on impulse, and fortunes can turn abruptly. At the extreme lies fanaticism, or simple burnout. High ideals need methodical, down-to-earth execution to hold them in place.

sagittarius_10.summary: A shrewd reader of the public whose cleverness needs a conscience.
sagittarius_10.fullText: Communicative and extremely adaptable, with an uncanny sense of what a crowd is thinking and a way of reflecting whatever surrounds it. The intellect is scientific and absorbs easily. Placements untangle hard problems and rise through tact and organising ability. Underneath runs something headstrong, aggressive and capable of deceit, which calls for firm moral discipline. Cleverness put to work for other people brings brilliant and lasting success. Used for manipulation or quarrels, it does not.

sagittarius_11.summary: Truth looked for in the body and in what plainly repeats.
sagittarius_11.fullText: An observant degree that corrects too much intellect with physical common sense. Placements notice that events are linked and that actions tend to return to whoever set them going. They are good at spotting natural patterns and the plain truths that follow from them. When the question is who they are, they consult the body's own knowledge before any theory. What they are after is a truth that needs no argument, found in the middle of life's repetitions.

sagittarius_12.summary: A forward-looking will that means to make its ideals real.
sagittarius_12.fullText: This degree faces the future almost entirely. Placements have moments of unusual height and a sense of destiny approaching. They feel called to bring their best ideals into ordinary material life, and they rely on spiritual will to do it. They often act as the first sign of something beginning. An awakening of some kind sets them on a more demanding road and asks them to go well past their former limits.

sagittarius_13.summary: Old accounts presented for settlement before anything new begins.
sagittarius_13.fullText: The past catches up here. As one phase of life closes, the consequences of earlier actions, good and bad alike, press in on present opportunities. Placements may find that buried secrets, old histories and business left unfinished come fully into view. The tradition reads this as a degree of reckoning. What has been hidden and what weighs on them has to be dealt with first, and only then can they go forward unburdened.

sagittarius_14.summary: Strength drawn from ancient knowledge and spiritual ancestry.
sagittarius_14.fullText: A lasting trust in an original tradition, and in the first principles thought to lie under everything that exists. Placements feel closely tied to their spiritual forebears and to wisdom handed down from earlier ages. That store of old knowledge gives them a firm base in a present-day crisis. They use the great achievements of the past as groundwork, and build on it toward developments that have not yet arrived.

sagittarius_15.summary: Testing the weather before committing to the season.
sagittarius_15.fullText: This degree checks before it moves. Placements watch for signs, try the ground, and want confirmation that conditions have changed before taking a new course. That gives them good timing and a sound instinct for when to hold back. It can also keep them waiting on an omen. The useful question here is a plain one: is it time to step out, or to stay in a while longer?

sagittarius_16.summary: Sensitivity that comes to depend on company for its supply.
sagittarius_16.fullText: The feelings and wants of this degree are readily stirred by the social surroundings and by circumstance. Placements adapt well. The pattern to watch is reliance: they learn to look to the group, or to some outside source, to satisfy an inner hunger, and gather wherever something is being handed out. Taking nourishment from the structures of society is reasonable. Losing the ability to provide for oneself is the cost to avoid.

sagittarius_17.summary: Shared renewal: hope taken up again in company.
sagittarius_17.fullText: A joyful and spiritually encouraging degree. Its subject is renewal, religious or cultural, of the kind that brings people together in a common rite of hope at the start of something. Placements draw great strength from taking part in a collective fresh beginning. They are optimists and look ahead with faith. Solidarity and shared devotion are what they lean on, and it brings them through dark periods in good order.

sagittarius_18.summary: Childlike curiosity that needs shade from too strong a light.
sagittarius_18.fullText: Innocence, youthfulness and protection are the themes. Placements approach life playfully and from a sheltered position, with a curiosity that can be naive. They are sensitive, and need something between themselves and the full glare of the world. The degree stands for a gentle introduction to wider experience, taken a little at a time, with safety and careful handling put first. Its strength is in the gradualness.

sagittarius_19.summary: The protective instinct that leaves a spoiled place for a clean one.
sagittarius_19.fullText: Nurturing and protective. Placements can tell when the place they live or work in has been fouled, physically or morally, by other people's carelessness. They will not have their children or their work harmed by it. So they pull up roots and move, which takes decision and nerve. This is a degree of strong survival instinct, and of looking for unspoiled ground in which later growth and well-being can be raised.

sagittarius_20.summary: Foresight that lays in supplies and finds promise in ordinary things.
sagittarius_20.fullText: Resourceful and forward-thinking. Placements plan for what will be needed later, reasoning from the regular cycle of the seasons, and store up in the hard months what the easy months will want. They work with the plain materials at hand and turn them into future benefit. Their conviction is that the common round of daily life is where anything remarkable has to happen. Under their hands the ordinary becomes a source of joy and of promise.

sagittarius_21.summary: Superior ability that must not borrow another person's identity.
sagittarius_21.fullText: A mind above the average, with bodily and mental energy held in balance and capable of reaching worldly and spiritual heights. The rise can be sudden: from obscurity to great influence, like a tidal wave arriving. The warning concerns imitation. Placements are tempted to take on a personality that is not theirs, or to copy the manner of people they admire. Success that lasts comes from an identity they have made themselves.

sagittarius_22.summary: A restless contrarian who must learn to get by on foreign ground.
sagittarius_22.fullText: Aggressive and unsettled, and usually at odds with accepted rules and public opinion. Placements reach for what cannot be had, and the result is inner conflict and a sense of crying out alone in the dark. Hostility is the way this degree damages itself. Its better course is practical. The background and culture they come from are assets, and used with skill they carry placements through unfamiliar surroundings and periods of transition.

sagittarius_23.summary: A stinging wit that gets things moving, and affections that need judgment.
sagittarius_23.fullText: Sharp-tongued, with a fine intellect and democratic instincts. Placements can stir people to act where nothing was happening before. The warnings are personal. Affections are insecure, confidence is given to the wrong people, and jealousy turns bitter. Where love is separated from discretion, the result is real restriction. The way forward is a deliberate choice to take up new opportunities and to leave old resentments where they lie.

sagittarius_24.summary: A mind fixed on fate and chance, rewarded for staying true.
sagittarius_24.fullText: Much preoccupied with fate. That shows in erratic decisions about money, in mistakes, and in projects that come to nothing. Without caution, placements may see a sudden reversal, or watch hard-earned resources scatter. The outlook is still good. If they stay true to themselves and take a positive part in the society around them, the tradition promises lasting happiness and good fortune in spite of the missteps.

sagittarius_25.summary: Romantic enthusiasm pulled between philosophy and pleasure.
sagittarius_25.fullText: Enthusiastic and romantic, strongly attracted to spiritual philosophy and just as strongly tempted by bodily indulgence. The pull of sport and physical pleasure competes with the wish to master something higher, and the tension is considerable. Placements have powers that are only beginning to show. By preparing to use them with discipline, they come through the spiritual struggle and arrive at a joy that is balanced and real.

sagittarius_26.summary: Loyalty behind a playful mask, given finally to an ideal.
sagittarius_26.fullText: Sympathetic and faithful. Placements may cover their depth with a light manner, or with a life given over to surface gaiety. They are frequently asked to put personal wishes second to a common aim or a higher ideal, and to stand up for a cause with no weapons to hand. Appearances mislead in this degree. Underneath is a nature capable of deep fidelity and of dedicating itself without thought of return.

sagittarius_27.summary: A visionary who gives ideals a tangible form.
sagittarius_27.fullText: Inspired, prophetic and creative. Placements work to give what they see inwardly a form that others can touch and be raised by. Opposition is strong, and they may feel hemmed in by powerful enemies. Their gift for shaping the world around them, eloquently, is what carries them past the sense of helplessness in the end. People who encounter the work find it healing.

sagittarius_28.summary: Patient, steady toil that others come to rely on.
sagittarius_28.fullText: Kindly, patient and steadfast. This degree expects hardship as a matter of course and gets over obstacles by work that does not stop. There is no bombast in it and no appetite for a fight. Placements stand between the gifts of exceptional individuals and the practical needs of the community, and serve as the bridge from one to the other. Their quiet persistence gives hope and security to those who depend on them.

sagittarius_29.summary: Cultured but timid, fond of show, steadied by everyday habit.
sagittarius_29.fullText: A cultivated mind, sometimes a nervous one, strongly attracted to pomp, glitter and travel. The attraction to vanity and display carries a risk: a sudden breakdown, or losing one's direction altogether. The safeguard is ordinary routine. Placements have remarkable physical agility, and when it is put to practical tasks and backed by constructive daily habits, they are protected from instability and keep a lasting respectability.

sagittarius_30.summary: A commanding intellect and guardian of established values.
sagittarius_30.fullText: Active and authoritative, able to keep up heavy work in order to get at nature's deeper secrets. Friends find placements indispensable and enemies find them formidable. They often take a position of high authority, or come to stand as a living emblem of traditional values. Uprightness that does not bend and a fighting spirit that does not tire are the means, and the tradition says they reach the first rank and real distinction.

capricorn_1.summary: Insight and command, with a second self kept out of view.
capricorn_1.fullText: Perceptive and self-possessed, with a strong will toward authority. Placements often come up from obscurity to prominence or executive control. The nature is double. Feelings run on two tracks, things are kept secret, and some lead what amounts to a second life, which complicates anything personal. Resilience protects them. Combativeness and diplomatic manoeuvring are the habits to drop. Sharp insight turned on themselves, and on what they owe to others, makes the success durable.

capricorn_2.summary: A versatile mind and a love of tradition, held back by indecision.
capricorn_2.fullText: Intelligent and many-sided, with real feeling for old traditions, for architecture and for sacred things. Initiative is strong, and so is the appetite for the highest kind of knowledge. What fails is commitment. Placements waver, lose focus, and can spend enormous effort carrying something pointless while a real opening passes. The outcome of that is scattered energy and disappointment. One worthy aim, pursued with resolution, takes this quick mind as high as it wants to go.

capricorn_3.summary: Great vitality and quick recovery, tested by its own fears.
capricorn_3.fullText: Strong constitution, strong ambition, and a shrewd, intuitive mind. Placements come back from illness or attack faster than anyone expects, and answer both with speed and some style. There is charm here and an aptitude for diplomacy, law or science. The recurring test is internal: this degree keeps being brought face to face with what it most dreads or dislikes. Harsh judgment, of others and of itself, is the habit to drop.

capricorn_4.summary: A noble, solitary guardian with a sense of appointed purpose.
capricorn_4.fullText: Refined and reflective, moved by inner ideals and a love of beauty and justice. Placements take the part of the lone keeper: a spiritual guide, a defender of the oppressed, someone tending a flame of knowledge so it does not go out. Many feel an odd, fated pull along a road already laid down, as if finishing something begun earlier. Purity of purpose matters most. Kept, it brings a prominent and respected place in the world.

capricorn_5.summary: Self-sufficient kindness that gives shelter, and is too trusting.
capricorn_5.fullText: Generous, broad-minded and needing nothing from anyone. Placements are a refuge for other people. Inner strength is great, and with it comes a grave awareness of how much suffering there is, which moves them to serve and protect whoever is in trouble. Their creative gifts need no applause, so they avoid display. The weakness is trust carried too far. Selflessness invites exploitation, and sharp discrimination is needed to protect a mission that is worth protecting.

capricorn_6.summary: Total devotion, in a faithful protector or a ruthless pragmatist.
capricorn_6.fullText: Capable of giving itself completely to one passion, one cause or one person. The degree cuts two ways. Placements may be the innocent, loyal guardian, or the cunning operator who will sacrifice others for advantage. They have a particular skill for boiling old wisdom down into practical use, and hold themselves to a strict code. Life here has concealed dangers. Careful judgment and intentions that stay kind are what keep the legacy from being one of cruelty or isolation.

capricorn_7.summary: An ingenious, secretive mind that gets caught in its own maze.
capricorn_7.fullText: Complicated and clever, with a real love of art and beauty. Placements tangle themselves in elaborate constructions of their own and in pessimistic fixed ideas. Rivalry and jealousy mark the life, and a good deal of the damage is self-inflicted. The need to control how things turn out, and a righteous grip on old grievances, bring progress to a halt and leave them alone. Grudges dropped and unfinished business completed, the intellect is free for something harmonious.

capricorn_8.summary: Solitary psychic depth, estranged from the everyday world.
capricorn_8.fullText: Intuitive, solitary and inclined to sadness. Placements feel out of place in ordinary life. They may have marked psychic ability or occult knowledge, and can pass on truths of a higher order for the guidance of others. Misused, for manipulation or for sensual excess, the same inner life turns into heavy sorrow, grievous loss, or a cynical distance from people. Meditation alone, strict discipline, and service in place of worldly power are where this degree finds its peace.

capricorn_9.summary: Inspired endurance on a steep road, with temper and appetite to master.
capricorn_9.fullText: A soul with large things to do and a hard climb to reach them. The trials are severe and tiring. Placements may contend with strong sensual appetites, or with a rough, irritable temper that drives off their supporters and prepares a tragic fall. They are led all the same by an inner light, and have a gift for healing through ritual, and for humility. With the lower instincts mastered and long labour given to a high cause, the end is illumination and an honoured name.

capricorn_10.summary: Prudent, wise and protective; a defender who asks for no credit.
capricorn_10.fullText: Careful and far-seeing, with a strong instinct to protect the vulnerable and to look for what is hidden. Night work, occultism and the less familiar sciences attract this degree, and placements feel fed by wild places and the unknown. They are militant in a good cause, and the zeal needs cooling so that it does not lead into needless danger. Quiet observation and a philosophical grasp of life's mysteries secure their success. Glory is not what they want.

capricorn_11.summary: Opposites pulled apart so that they can be joined again.
capricorn_11.fullText: Opposing forces meet here, and the strain between them shapes the whole life. Placements are driven to bring the two back together. That means standing between careful discrimination and complete letting-go, and between tradition and what is new, giving each its due. The task is large and belongs to more than one person. It is also the making of them: conviction, sympathy, and acceptance of what cannot be avoided open the way to wholeness.

capricorn_12.summary: A retentive, observant mind for study, with cunning to guard against.
capricorn_12.fullText: Memory is exceptional and observation close. Placements are fitted for deep study of nature and of hidden things, and for research or teaching. The caution is specific. Craftiness, secret dealing and predatory behaviour are the temptations of a mind this capable. Used to manipulate people, the gift spoils. Used to find out what is true, it brings substantial and lasting success in whatever field they choose.

capricorn_13.summary: A bold, self-made leader whose severity needs tempering.
capricorn_13.fullText: Adventurous and fiery, and thoughtful with it. Placements want new territory, or old wisdom dug up again, and are after truth without qualification. They are highly capable, usually self-made, and do not avoid a risk. Harshness is the fault. They can be exacting, critical and at worst ruthlessly aggressive. The drive to conquer needs honest reflection and compassion beside it, and with those this degree reaches the best it is capable of.

capricorn_14.summary: An incisive critic who uncovers facts and is seldom satisfied.
capricorn_14.fullText: Piercing, inquisitive and analytical. This degree takes structures and beliefs apart as a matter of habit. It produces good researchers, statisticians and critics, people who bring important truths to light. The same fault-finding breeds discontent and friction with others. Emotional steadiness has to be worked at, and a negative or combative turn avoided. The intellect is best used to refine and improve what is there. Pulling it down is the easier and lesser use.

capricorn_15.summary: Devoted service to others, carried mostly alone.
capricorn_15.fullText: A large capacity for devotion and self-sacrifice, and a real concern for other people's welfare. Placements take on heavy responsibility. They are drawn to nursing and healing, or to the deeper questions of science and human life. The road is often lonely. Recognition is scarce, setbacks come suddenly, and worldly struggle can feel overwhelming. Fulfilment comes from keeping the ideal high and continuing to comfort others whether or not anything comes back.

capricorn_16.summary: Youthful, sociable and gentle, and too soft for a hard knock.
capricorn_16.fullText: Youth, physical fitness and social life are the interests. Placements want to stay young and throw themselves into community activity. The nature is easygoing and sympathetic. It is also too tender to meet the world's harder difficulties head on. The risks are self-indulgence and a reliance on passive resistance alone. Gentle ideals are easily corrupted from outside, and this degree has to build some inner toughness in order to keep them.

capricorn_17.summary: A many-sided, private character that will not be classified.
capricorn_17.fullText: A puzzling degree that combines traits which seem not to belong together. Placements are deeply secretive and deeply faithful, and guard the private self fiercely. The intellect is shrewd and analytical. They can change dramatically and fit themselves to almost any role. The danger lies in the secrecy. If it slides into unreliability or hidden motives that do harm, the result is serious friction with others and isolation within.

capricorn_18.summary: A competitor's courage, in a life of conflict and sharp reversals.
capricorn_18.fullText: Striving, rivalry and repeated collisions with outside hardship. Placements have an aggressive spirit that does not give way, and are attracted to high risk, physical effort and dramatic turns of fortune. They can ride out a very heavy storm and keep their dignity. What threatens the ground under them is avoidable: disputes that need not have been joined, gambling, and destructive anger. Wariness on those three points is the whole advice.

capricorn_19.summary: Self-reliant endurance that shoulders the load and will not bend.
capricorn_19.fullText: Great stamina of body and mind. Placements are ready for heavy responsibility and can get value out of the hardest circumstances. They are independent, resourceful and tenacious in their convictions, which makes them formidable in business or politics. Stubbornness is the price. A refusal to adapt leaves them alone. Success of the best kind needs some emotional give alongside the relentless drive for material or social achievement.

capricorn_20.summary: A receptive, adaptable nature that steadies the people around it.
capricorn_20.fullText: Intuitive and spiritually inclined, with a talent for bringing harmony into a room. Placements adapt easily and do well in shared, artistic or public work, where connection is the point. Others take encouragement from them. The risks are on the surface: vanity, imitation in place of substance, and a restlessness that moves on too soon. Held in check, the gift produces something lasting.

capricorn_21.summary: A studious reformer who joins old knowledge to present need.
capricorn_21.fullText: Studious, intuitive and energetic, drawn to ancient wisdom, to science and to the large questions of human life. Placements work well with others and want to reform things. They make original discoveries and not uncommonly found a new school of thought. The presence is magnetic, sometimes romantic. Over-sensitivity and emotional escape are the pitfalls. Methodical research and a liking for fair competition ground the work, and it can change a society.

capricorn_22.summary: Resolute labour that learns equally from winning and losing.
capricorn_22.fullText: Hard-working and exceptionally determined. Placements want to raise others up and to build on a sound base, and they do not avoid heavy or difficult tasks. Endurance of body and mind is great. Ambition is intense and stubbornness goes with it, and both need direction or they harden into ruthlessness. A philosophical view of life's battles helps. Taking defeat and victory with equal grace, they leave a well-earned record of strength and protection.

capricorn_23.summary: Genial, passionate and brave, in need of moderation.
capricorn_23.fullText: Intelligent and warm, meeting life with great enthusiasm and plenty of company. Placements are capable of real bravery and of winning the rewards society gives. The danger is excess: extravagance, self-indulgence, and reckless love affairs. Resources are overstretched and feelings get out of hand, and a sudden reversal can cost what was hard to earn. With discipline, the love of comfort sits alongside acts of heroism and considerable philosophical depth.

capricorn_24.summary: Sincere, orderly and practical, with faith that sees it through.
capricorn_24.fullText: Steadfast and unassuming, a natural protector and organiser of whatever is near. Placements often feel marked out by destiny and are drawn to aims beyond the ordinary and to serious spiritual commitment. An orderly mind and firm faith bring them clear of approaching danger, sometimes narrowly. They want to face the world's illusions and are good at reducing a complicated problem to its simplest truth. In the laboratory or the cloister, sincerity is what defeats deceit and adversity.

capricorn_25.summary: Charm and good fortune, resting on too little substance.
capricorn_25.fullText: Sociable, expansive and fond of comfort, art and luxury. Placements attract luck, wealthy partners and influential positions with apparent ease. They are inclined to harvest what others planted and to prefer a light, passing existence to long hard work. Vanity and shallowness leave them exposed to sudden reversal and to enemies they have not noticed. Imagination needs grounding and real substance needs building, so that pleasure-seeking turns into something creative.

capricorn_26.summary: Calm on the surface, strong underneath, and happiest outdoors.
capricorn_26.fullText: Compassionate, independent and fond of nature. The manner is tranquil and conceals great inner strength. Placements want to protect the vulnerable and to see the world, and do best in open country. A rich imagination lets them adapt to almost anything. The risk is escape. Unchecked impulse, or a wish to avoid conflict altogether, ends in drifting. With discipline and a hold on their deep reserves of feeling, they become a steady and persuasive force for humane ends.

capricorn_27.summary: A gruff, authentic nature that prefers quiet work to notice.
capricorn_27.fullText: Rugged and inward, with no patience for social pretence. A rough exterior covers a thoughtful, kind and devoted heart. Placements rise slowly and by steady application, toward mastery of a practical or a spiritual kind. They are happiest in peaceful country places and out of the limelight. Too much solitude is the hazard, and with it a sour view of humankind. Patient and unpretentious, they steady others and give sound, healing advice to those who ask.

capricorn_28.fullText: A strong, exact and capable intellect. Placements may serve as a dependable guide, work at the frontier of a science, or carry through a very large organisational task. Their concentration is such that petty critics go unnoticed and enormous burdens are brought to completion. Wealth and authority may follow. So does the weight of duty, which they feel keenly. Exhaustion is the danger, and lighter pleasures, simple recreation and some spiritual joy are the remedy.

capricorn_29.summary: A contemplative reader of nature's signs, prone to low spirits.
capricorn_29.fullText: Philosophical and deeply intuitive. Placements learn by watching nature quietly and by attending to the meanings underneath things. They are given to melancholy and to living alone. Their ability to read life's subtle marks, and to connect the wisdom of the past with the present, makes them good guides. Competition does not interest them; silent communion with universal law does. Poetic and visionary as they are, fatalistic gloom has to be resisted.

capricorn_30.summary: Executive ambition aimed at the top, and liable to fall as fast as it rises.
capricorn_30.fullText: Forceful, ambitious and commanding, intent on the highest levels of power and influence. The mind is very quick and can concentrate hard. Restlessness and impulse give the career the path of a meteor: a sudden ascent, and the risk of an equally sudden drop. Pride and the hostility of powerful rivals are what bring it down. Self-mastery is essential. So is a willingness to discuss and collaborate, which turns raw determination into lasting standing.

aquarius_1.summary: A pioneering mind for science or humane work, needing firm ground.
aquarius_1.fullText: Independent and imaginative, with a strong bent for science, invention or leadership in a humanitarian cause. Placements see the wider picture. They want to bring out ideas that are fresh and their own, and that will outlast them. The practical work is the difficulty. A habit of standing aloof, or of living in dreams that cannot be carried out, wastes the promise and lets opportunities go. Vision here has to be tied down to fact.

aquarius_2.summary: A capable, organised intellect that rebuilds better after each shock.
aquarius_2.fullText: Observant, orderly and highly able, good at business, scientific research or strategy. Placements are practical and on the whole lucky. Even so, life delivers sudden storms: reversals nobody predicted, and shocks that go deep. Temper and withdrawal are the wrong responses. Inner security is the right one. With it, a crisis strips away what was unnecessary, and they build again on ground that is firmer and better understood.

aquarius_3.summary: Resilience that breaks with old loyalties to find its own way.
aquarius_3.fullText: Courageous and intuitive, attracted to the unusual, to the natural world, or to metaphysics. Deep changes go on inside. Placements often feel they must reject confining social rules or former allegiances outright in order to discover who they are. The price can be severe: shocks to body or feeling, and long stretches alone. Faith and perseverance carry them, and the freedom they reach in the end is bright and thoroughly earned.

aquarius_4.summary: A sensitive idealist with a gift for healing, mental or physical.
aquarius_4.fullText: Refined, poetic and kind. Placements have an unusual ability to bring spiritual energy to bear on practical relief, and to ease other people's suffering. They are sociable, eccentric, and inclined to wander, and their warmth gathers friends and admirers with no effort. The calling is to bring peace and light to people in distress. Frivolity, vanity and the distraction of their own sensual wishes are what stand between them and it.

aquarius_5.summary: Independent leadership that stands on inherited ground.
aquarius_5.fullText: Ardent, idealistic and unafraid of a challenge. Placements think clearly and draw real strength from tradition or family roots, which is why they step forward when things go wrong. They can carry large aims through to the end. What undoes them is their own certainty: stubbornness, overconfidence and a taste for long odds. A miscalculation here tends to be a public one, so moderation is what secures the honours.

aquarius_6.summary: A sharp, inventive progressive, drawn to a public or ceremonial part.
aquarius_6.fullText: Critical, quick and original. Placements are committed progressives who enjoy experimental ideas and truths that apply everywhere. They like to stand where a group's energy gathers, and express their ideals through drama, ceremony or public office. The gift for communication is fierce. Used to win arguments, it produces endless disputes and drives supporters away. Used in real service to others, with some compassion, it does what they hoped it would.

aquarius_7.summary: Tact and insight that announce a wider way of seeing.
aquarius_7.fullText: Courteous, intricate and deeply intuitive. What placements do tends to signal a new and broader outlook arriving. The temperament is calm. They read people remarkably well and keep spiritual insight and practical affairs in balance. The temptation is to pull back into a sheltered, defenceless privacy. Resisting it, they use a generous breadth of mind to bring about real social change and to give their community an entirely new framework.

aquarius_8.summary: Forceful determination that escapes its own confinement and sets an example.
aquarius_8.fullText: Intense and resolute, and somewhat dogmatic. Placements feel shut in by circumstance, by surroundings, or by habits of their own that have set hard. They have a soldier's energy and a great thirst for release, and the courage to break out of a prison whether it is physical or mental. Afterwards, their conduct and their hard-won wisdom become a pattern for others. Respect follows, and so does a plain demonstration of what people can come through.

aquarius_9.summary: An idealist who can make a principle into a living force.
aquarius_9.fullText: Alert, optimistic and fearless, forever looking for final truths and principles that hold everywhere. The rare ability here is embodiment. Placements can take a great idea and personify it so completely that a symbol becomes an active power for change. They succeed in business and in social reform. Pace is the hazard. Impulsive, fast-moving energy causes accidents, to the body or the feelings, unless mature judgment is in charge.

aquarius_10.summary: A serious figure made into a public symbol, who must stay himself.
aquarius_10.fullText: Observant, practical and responsible, taking a wide view and approaching problems from unexpected angles. Placements catch the public imagination easily. They find themselves pushed forward as the face of a popular ideal or movement. The lesson of the degree is that this kind of fame is temporary and not really about them. Their task is to keep their own integrity intact while the crowd attaches its hopes to them and then moves on.

aquarius_11.summary: Sudden inspiration and inventive power, needing moral discipline.
aquarius_11.fullText: A lively, inventive mind open to flashes of inspiration strong enough to change the direction of a life. Placements join progressive or humanitarian movements and want to make work that lasts and improves society. The dangers are headlong force and rushing at risks they have not looked at. Easy, short-lived popularity tempts them, and so do darker, self-defeating impulses that only scatter what they have. Ideals held in place by firm morals bring brilliant, durable success.

aquarius_12.summary: A reformer and teacher who must not turn bitter when disappointed.
aquarius_12.fullText: Sensitive and idealistic, with an understanding of how human beings develop that goes unusually deep. Placements are natural healers or instructors. They help others upward and keep their own spiritual values while doing it. Imagination is poetic, sympathy wide, and public service a common choice. Seeing the world's inequalities so clearly, they risk heavy disillusionment. Cynical secrecy, cold withdrawal and crippling doubt are the responses to refuse.

aquarius_13.summary: An objective reader of signs, who should keep one foot at home.
aquarius_13.fullText: Perceptive, curious and detached. Placements read the small indications in nature and in society, see a trend before it arrives, and get at basic natural facts. That lets them plan with great accuracy. They often feel pushed toward the unknown and may cut every tie with the past in order to go their own way. Occult or scientific discernment is the gain. Ordinary domestic harmony is the counterweight, and without it they come dangerously adrift.

aquarius_14.summary: A restless, many-sided mind with too much in hand at once.
aquarius_14.fullText: Active and versatile, usually running several projects or philosophies together. Placements are drawn to psychological depths and feel obliged to look into the most concealed parts of human nature, clearing up what people in general prefer not to see. Resourcefulness gets them round the usual obstacles and into new connections. Dispersed energy brings anxiety, nervous exhaustion or accidents. A single steady aim, and a settled home to lean on, make the ambition safe.

aquarius_15.summary: Cosmopolitan confidence and good fortune, at risk of setting hard.
aquarius_15.fullText: Adventurous and communicative, steered by a faith that does not shake. Placements have a flair for leadership and a real appreciation of what is beautiful in life. Friends, money and public recognition come readily. They travel, read and explore, and spread optimism as they go. The fault is unexpected: too much consistency. They can become fixed in repeated habits or in a public character they built with care. Staying emotionally flexible keeps the momentum.

aquarius_16.summary: A commanding organiser of large affairs, who must not lose the human side.
aquarius_16.fullText: Robust and methodical. Placements manage big undertakings, complicated systems and intricate technical arrangements, and do it well. They are fired by a wish to be of practical use and have the exactness that solid worldly achievement requires. In business, law or science the approach is rational and asks for proof. The warning is that results can crowd out compassion. When that happens, life answers with disorder they cannot manage, or a barrenness of feeling.

aquarius_17.summary: Vigilant independence that guards its own, and risks ending up alone.
aquarius_17.fullText: Protective, self-governing and a little eccentric. Placements watch over their autonomy and their resources without letting up.
