They feel close to ancient wisdom, analyse sharply, and have the quiet toughness to stand against general opinion. Investigative or highly specialised work suits them. Distrust of people, extreme obstinacy and outright suspicion threaten to cut them off entirely. Warmth, an open mind and a readiness to share what they see are the correctives.

aquarius_18.summary: A hard start, a guarded manner, and a reckoning that clears the air.
aquarius_18.fullText: Analytical, complicated and fiercely independent, shaped by early difficulty. Placements tend to keep their motives private, work by unusual methods, and cover vulnerability with composure. At some point the cover comes off, in public or in private, and that moment is the turning point. With suspicion set down and damaging attachments avoided, the strategic mind that got them through hardship takes them somewhere considerably brighter.

aquarius_19.summary: Calm calculation that puts out fires and succeeds late.
aquarius_19.fullText: Observant, composed and very hard to defeat. This degree lives through great changes of fortune and through public upheaval. Placements repeatedly face blazes of feeling or circumstance, and have the detachment and inner reserve to put them out and restore order. They act on careful reckoning and psychological insight, never on a rash impulse, and express themselves gracefully. Their best and most lasting success, and their recognition, come in the second half of life.

aquarius_20.summary: A patient, gifted go-between, working through quiet intention.
aquarius_20.fullText: Enduring and charismatic, with deep intuition and refined talent in music, art or science. Placements often carry something of a spiritual message to the people around them. They meet the hardest challenges with a faith that is close to mystical. Their power is quiet and connective, and what they intend inwardly matters far more than any outward show. Dictatorial pride is the one thing to resist. Otherwise success, long life and wide respect come naturally.

aquarius_21.summary: Disappointment met with self-command, and turned to others' good.
aquarius_21.fullText: A degree that has to face disillusion: hopes that failed, or circumstances that feel empty. Where passion goes unchecked, placements meet abrupt reversals or are pulled into violent, destructive outbursts. The other course takes courage. Trials are accepted, with no giving in to despair and no revenge. Strength grows from that, and past injuries become a renewed ability to guide and protect other people. The fulfilment is real and owes nothing to appearances.

aquarius_22.summary: Diligent craft and cooperation, with what is built kept safe.
aquarius_22.fullText: Hard-working and conscientious. Placements do best in methodical work, mutual help and shared effort, and take real satisfaction in it. The limelight does not attract them. They would sooner lay a secure foundation by quiet craftsmanship and give warmth, shelter and understanding to those nearby. One caution applies. What they have built, and the comforts they have earned, need protecting against sudden hazards and natural disaster. Success arrives steadily and by humble means.

aquarius_23.summary: Self-discipline and gentle resilience in an artistic or spiritual nature.
aquarius_23.fullText: Intuitive, with gifts for art, letters or spiritual things. Self-discipline is the strength. Placements acquire unusual skills by unconventional training, by learning alone, or through hard experience. They may be frail in body or feeling, and lack aggressive drive, and they bend when adversity blows hard. They do not break. Literary, artistic or botanical talent, cultivated, lets them pass on real wisdom and turn hardship into something beautiful that lasts.

aquarius_24.summary: Turbulent passion that becomes wisdom once it is mastered.
aquarius_24.fullText: The central matter is an inner fight to tame desires that are deep and stormy. Left alone, they lead to vindictiveness, to violent scenes, or to severe censure from society. Placements learn most from their worst experiences, including the ones they brought on themselves. With the primitive instincts conquered, dark feeling is changed into understanding. In the end they teach and guide people who are travelling the same troubled road.

aquarius_25.summary: A brilliant reasoner who can walk straight into a hole.
aquarius_25.fullText: Logical and highly perceptive, and in some respects ahead of ordinary development. Placements live by strict discipline and restraint. They lean so heavily on reason that instinct and plain practical fact are ignored, and the imbalance is dangerous. Intellectual arrogance, or a want of grounded experience, sends them toward disaster without seeing it. Wiser companions are worth listening to. Everyday common sense has to keep pace with the mental brilliance.

aquarius_26.summary: Practical, sociable efficiency, with a clear eye for how things work.
aquarius_26.fullText: Good at analysing and managing whatever is going on around it. Placements may apply technical skill to everyday problems, or run a comfortable and welcoming household, and in both cases enjoy serving and connecting with their community. The intellect is sharp and observant. It collects facts readily and understands mechanisms. One caution: a fascination with the shallow or decaying side of society. A wholesome, productive and independent life is the better aim.

aquarius_27.summary: Delicate feeling and old values, choosing between honest work and escape.
aquarius_27.fullText: Refined and sensitive, able to make things of lasting beauty and to keep faith with tradition. The choice before this degree is stark. On one side stands disciplined, patient effort. On the other stand gambling, addiction and lazy escape, to all of which placements are unusually exposed. Self-control and plain, honest industry decide it. By laying the ground for the future steadily and refusing dissipated habits, they build a life with meaning and artistic reward.

aquarius_28.summary: Provident skill that cuts a way through and lays in for hard times.
aquarius_28.fullText: Remarkable ability to carry things out, to attack a problem and to defend a position. Placements look ahead intelligently and secure what will be needed before the difficult season arrives. The mind is sharp and penetrating. They take real pleasure in practical preparation and in doing a task exactly. The road involves hard labour and strict self-discipline. Continuous, well-planned effort earns honourable success, and with it security and distinction.

aquarius_29.summary: Commanding ambition that must be remade from within.
aquarius_29.fullText: Natural authority, strict integrity and a wish to accomplish something large. Placements often rise to positions of executive power. Their real success lies elsewhere, in breaking out of old confining patterns and passing through a complete change of the inner self. It is a critical passage. Those who come through it are more developed and clearer in mind, able to hold substantial influence and remain entirely calm within.

aquarius_30.summary: Serene intuition that joins old wisdom to what is coming.
aquarius_30.fullText: Calm and whole in outlook, with a strong feeling of connection to everything else and of human brotherhood. Placements get beyond ordinary limits and find beauty and new life among the remains of the past. Judgment is sober and logical, and joined to a natural leaning toward occult or spiritual arts. They trust quiet inner realisations and stay open to the highest influences. The result is a harmonious self-mastery, and a part in beginning new cycles.

pisces_1.summary: Generous, adaptable and at ease in a crowd, where it brings unlike things together.
pisces_1.fullText: Compassionate and open-handed, with literary or artistic tastes and a broad feeling for humanity. Placements do well in busy, public settings, and in trade and exchange. They reconcile elements that would otherwise pull apart. Blending in comes naturally, and they sense the mood of a group at once. The same gift makes them easy to sway, and they can lose themselves among other people. Integrity kept, they gain lasting success and a peaceful home.

pisces_2.summary: Intuitive and sympathetic, undermined by idleness and by reliance on luck.
pisces_2.fullText: Instinctive and highly sensitive, with a pull toward spiritual or philosophical matters. Placements are sociable and persuasive, widely imaginative, and tender toward anyone who suffers. Three habits work against them: laziness, extreme restlessness, and a way of putting on one disguise after another to avoid facing hard facts. Speculation is a hazard too. Practical firmness, and less dependence on chance or on other people's work, prevent the sudden setback and the self-made struggle.

pisces_3.summary: An original, psychic mind standing between two worlds.
pisces_3.fullText: Unusually perceptive, hospitable and magnetic. Placements often act as a link between material life and the spiritual. They can draw on what people in general are thinking and feeling, and use an inventive mind to find a way through situations that are complicated or concealed. A deep inner life and a grasp of human nature bring them money and influential friends. The urge to retreat inward is strong. Scattering, secrecy and loss of touch with practical reality are the risks.

pisces_4.summary: Steady and self-reliant in confusion, a light others steer by.
pisces_4.fullText: Intense, creative and something of a medium, and at the same time self-sufficient and good at getting things done. Placements frequently find themselves in the middle of disorder, under pressure from outside, or in narrow and confining circumstances. They hold firm and others take direction from them. They are highly impressionable and seem to draw strength from life itself. Fear and melancholy can paralyse. Looking upward, and trusting their own inner strength, keeps them in command.

pisces_5.summary: Warm, sociable and fond of comfort, with ideals to keep in step with spending.
pisces_5.fullText: Generous and expansive, drawn to beauty, comfort and pleasure. Under that lies a real spiritual or pioneering impulse, and placements often succeed by gathering people around a shared aim or a charity. The risks follow from their tastes. Love of luxury, romantic adventure and speculative ventures stretch them too far and can turn their fortunes suddenly. Imagination tied to practical dedication achieves a good deal, for themselves and for others.

pisces_6.summary: Formidable focus that rebuilds after a collapse and leads others out.
pisces_6.fullText: Steadfast, observant and resourceful. Placements meet serious difficulty more than once, and may have to reconstruct their lives after an abrupt fall. They are well equipped for it: strong concentration, diplomatic skill, and a determination that is close to military. They overcome adversity and lead. The manner can seem proud, remote or stern. What moves them is devotion to duty and a settled confidence that they will come through.

pisces_7.summary: A reflective, divided nature that reaches clarity through concentration.
pisces_7.fullText: Exceptional ability in art, mysticism or scholarship. The temperament is complex and changeable, warmly sociable at one time and cool and distant at another. Placements live with sharp oppositions and feel life as a contest between materialism and a higher idealism. The way through is a single constructive purpose. Their great power of concentration, given to that and lit by a steady inner conviction, lifts them above the conflict and leaves work that inspires.

pisces_8.summary: A strong voice that rouses the community, and must know its limits.
pisces_8.fullText: Intuitive, outspoken and committed, with a deep sense of responsibility and a wish to bring people together. Placements are sympathetic and feel close to the earth and to the common human struggle. They can succeed in practical terms and have real influence where they live. Trouble comes when they overrate their capacity and try to force a result that is beyond them. Humility, and a true estimate of their calling, make them a powerful awakening influence.

pisces_9.summary: Sensitive, romantic and fiercely driven to outrun every rival.
pisces_9.fullText: An uncommon mixture of acute sensitivity, romance and restless force. Placements take adventurous or unconventional roads. They grasp difficult ideas very quickly, and their ambition to leave competitors behind, and to master the darker part of themselves, is strong to the point of fierceness. So much energy gathered together achieves a lot. It also exposes them to emotional extremes, to exhaustion, and to aimless wandering. Discipline keeps the talent fixed to something real.

pisces_10.summary: A brilliant, volatile independent, at home in the upper reaches of thought.
pisces_10.fullText: Highly capable and impossible to confine. Placements refuse ordinary social limits and seem able to rise above natural ones, taking in large currents of thought and moving easily in advanced philosophy, science or the occult. Their outlook is broad and their sympathy for mankind real. Radical restlessness, or a detached sadness, can leave them alone with it. Fulfilment comes from bringing their insights down into organised teaching or leadership that benefits others.

pisces_11.summary: Love of liberty joined to an intuitive search for truth.
pisces_11.fullText: Independent, and intent on finding out what is true by its own lights. Placements may seem restless, or cramped by ordinary limits. They are faithful and protective, and still need freedom to make their own way toward understanding. Anxiety works against them. So does refusing every limitation, since ambitions that accept none are apt to be cut short early. A steady aim and their natural alertness see the search through.

pisces_12.summary: Creative brilliance put through hard tests of character.
pisces_12.fullText: Sensitive, inventive and possibly brilliant. The life includes severe trials of character and commitment. Placements struggle with self-doubt and with sudden breaks in their fortunes, and are tempted to escape into romance or art. Success has conditions. They must accept personal responsibility, choose one road, and overcome the cowardly wish to run from a real challenge. Those who stand fast reach the spiritual or intellectual standing they wanted.

pisces_13.summary: Honest perseverance that lays down its arms and finds security.
pisces_13.fullText: Hard-working, truthful and harmonious by nature. Security comes through persistence and through drawing on what earlier experience taught. Early life may have involved fierce battles, private or public. Peace and stability arrive when placements retire their aggressive defences and take up an ordered, cooperative way of living. Others rely on them as a steady link. Their footing is practical service, natural good sense and a united home.

pisces_14.summary: A sharp, ambitious mind with a sense of mission, safest when honest.
pisces_14.fullText: Active and quick, and convinced of having a particular task or destiny. Placements are direct, and have the protective cunning that dangerous, competitive surroundings call for. The faults are a headstrong, aggressive approach and too much reliance on deception. Either one raises concealed enemies and secret dangers. Honest, dedicated work brings success. Subtlety of mind is properly used here as a shield, and badly used as a weapon.

pisces_15.summary: Vigilant devotion that guards its own with great caution.
pisces_15.fullText: Devoted, watchful and highly protective, taking every care to make its territory secure. Placements can carry heavy responsibility and teach or defend others. Foresight is sharp, and there is a soldier's readiness about them. Two tendencies need moderating: nervousness, and a forceful, domineering manner. Unchecked, they wear placements out or drive away the people being protected. Patient, lasting industry is how they secure the future of family or community.

pisces_16.summary: Inspired and solitary, needing company and firm ground.
pisces_16.fullText: Creative and sensitive, receiving inspiration of a high order, and sometimes isolated because of it. The spirit is daring and independent. Cut off too far from other people, placements risk a sudden and complete collapse, or estrangement from society. Visionary ideals need fastening to practical fact, and supportive friendships need cultivating. Otherwise the end can be a tragic fall, a hermit's bitterness, or a pessimism that destroys. In balance, a powerful inner life brings wide reputation.

pisces_17.summary: Bold energy for large aims and renewal, short on forethought.
pisces_17.fullText: Magnetic, vigorous and ambitious for achievement on a large scale and for a fresh start that is shared publicly. Placements inspire others and take up new beginnings with joy. They are also impulsive, headstrong and reckless, and this brings heavy setbacks and sudden dangers. An ambitious leap can end in a very hard landing. Forethought, control of a combative temper, and a secure, balanced base are the three things that prevent it.

pisces_18.summary: Incisive persuasion that is drawn too readily into a fight.
pisces_18.fullText: Intense and sharp-minded, with a talent for influencing people dramatically. The disposition is assertive and combative. It keeps running the risk of destructive quarrels, of lawsuits, and of traps laid by dishonest people. Placements can fall victim to their own aggression or to the schemes of secret enemies. The fierce energy is better spent raising others up than contending for worldly advantage. Faith maintained, they get the better of serious adversity.

pisces_19.summary: A receptive, philosophical mind hungry for truth, and inclined to scatter.
pisces_19.fullText: Thoughtful and spiritually eager. Placements look for deep knowledge and want to hand on truths that do not change. The calling is high and the difficulties are ordinary: serious indecision, energy spread too thin, and an imagination so busy that it tires out body and feelings. Wandering and restlessness have to give way. Firm faith, concentrated study and commitment to one purposeful road bring both success and healing.

pisces_20.summary: Artistic, responsive and hospitable, needing routine as an anchor.
pisces_20.fullText: Highly sensitive and quick to respond to feeling. Placements are attuned to giving others comfort, food and entertainment. The mind is fast and intuitive, and plenty and social harmony tend to come their way. Stability is the weak point. They are prone to drifting, to unpredictable moods, and to dark, fatalistic imaginings. Practical routines hold the creative and hospitable gifts steady, and with them comes fulfilment that lasts.

pisces_21.summary: An instinctive, psychic nature swept along by the moment.
pisces_21.fullText: At ease in psychic states and in trance, and ready to give itself up to whatever is passing. Placements are emotional, mediumistic and full of vital force. They live in expectation that something unknown, wonderful or terrible, is about to break through. The course of life has a fated quality and varies wildly, with periods of complete absence followed by a strong return. Extraordinary events give them energy, and deeper currents move through them by instinct.

pisces_22.summary: A bearer of new instructions who must make them work in ordinary life.
pisces_22.fullText: The task is to carry clear understanding down from a moment of great height into daily living. Placements act as messengers for a new law or a revelation. They have to translate it into something that functions, and must not use the message for personal profit. The test is whether the new code agrees with inner truth and honest intention. Where it does, they inspire others deeply and help bring about a renewal that is shared.

pisces_23.summary: Concentrated will that gives its own vitality to make an ideal real.
pisces_23.fullText: Placements are able to give substance to what they inwardly desire and consciously believe, and they spend their own life-force doing it. They have a passion for getting at the final realities of existence and rely on a focused inner power to see past surfaces. Two dangers stand out: fanaticism, and the darker temptation to use the ability for deception. At its best this degree brings deeply held spiritual truths into physical fact.

pisces_24.summary: Happiness made within limits, in a small and close community.
pisces_24.fullText: This degree understands that a settled, satisfying life begins with accepting one's own limits. Placements often live or work in a small, closely knit group, or in a place set apart, and make a world of their own there. Compromise is part of it, and so is care for good relations with neighbours. Joy and fellowship hold, however large or disorderly things are outside. Meaning is found in shared closeness, and endless expansion adds nothing to it.

pisces_25.summary: Resilient integrity that clears out corruption and restores what was meant.
pisces_25.fullText: The subject here is the capacity of the inner self to step in and bring on a needed cleansing. Placements set themselves against practices that have gone wrong and influences that corrupt their surroundings. They pass through a thorough purification, personal and spiritual, removing what is harmful so that true ideals can be set up again. The tradition gives them the victory. Strict inner honesty can redeem even a badly spoiled situation.

pisces_26.summary: A sense of timing that knows when to begin.
pisces_26.fullText: Observant and forward-looking, with a sharp feeling for the right moment and for meeting a challenge in one's own way. Placements work at the turning points, where one cycle is finishing and the next has hardly started. They notice small signals in their surroundings and can tell when a project of their own ought to be started. Because they stay so closely attuned to slight changes, their ambitions are carried out with precision.

pisces_27.summary: Abundant energy at harvest, which still has to be brought in.
pisces_27.fullText: A season of great fertility and high energy, when long effort yields plentifully. There is a strong sense of culmination, and good reason to celebrate with family and friends. The warning is not to relax too soon. Placements need firm self-discipline to finish the job in hand, or what they worked for is left to spoil. Celebration in measure, and attention kept up to the end, bring returns that are splendid and sustaining.

pisces_28.summary: Fullness and contentment: the rewards of labour enjoyed at their height.
pisces_28.fullText: Basic needs fully met and life's good things enjoyed with real delight. Placements are at the peak of emotional and creative fertility. Their situation is full of reward and of chances for something new to be born. These are high-water marks, and intense ones. Keeping an even balance through them lets the harvest be enjoyed completely before the cycle declines, as it will. The degree stands for earthly growth and spiritual contentment brought to completion.

pisces_29.summary: Brilliant discipline in pursuit of a perfect performance.
pisces_29.fullText: Sparkling and severely self-trained. Placements are after perfection in the conduct of life and fluency on several levels at once. They can see what a situation would look like fully realised, and will put themselves through hard trials and corrective training to match it. Close self-observation and restraint give them a masterly ability to reinvent themselves and to express what is real in them. Mastery here comes from complete submission to the craft.

pisces_30.summary: The last degree: becoming what one has kept in view.
pisces_30.fullText: The zodiac ends on a degree about sustained attention. Placements fix on an image of what they admire and, by giving it feeling and will over a long time, grow to resemble it. That makes the choice of ideal the whole matter, since a small one is achieved just as faithfully as a great one. As the closing degree it also holds the start of the next cycle.
